body:
Declined as superseded by a completed, newer independent review—not for lack of capacity.

In /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/rust/mote, bead bd-01M1DBERGRFM6ETT3RYX31VSF8 already carries the exact commit-bound review by codex-mote-recovery-review-v2, session sess-01M1E8G52GRP8F6HAQ6DVHAM8B. Current HEAD is still the reviewed 85a0cc7a01bb3b12d4e4fd26a6ca1cb82c115672; the only worktree addition is the excluded .claude/scheduled_tasks.lock.

That review BLOCKED with a runnable reducer-level falsifier: ExplicitOperatorOverride accepts omitted review_policy_op_id and landing_repository_op_id after compatibility normalization, although the CLI populates them. It priced the repair: retain omission tolerance only for ProposalAuthorizer reconciliation, require both clocks before normalization for ExplicitOperatorOverride, and add the negative court. Exact-head full/focused courts were otherwise green. No successor commit is present yet.

I did not claim the Rust review bead, reserve paths, rerun a duplicate full court, or change either repository. Re-request focused review when a successor contains the missing-clock repair.
